purpose: Preserve RF + Conformer + AlexNet and test genuine four/five-model additions on saved paired splits
user_instruction: Original three models remain fixed; add models rather than automatically replace RF. Interpret 14 as four from context.
training_policy: clean_only, including candidate selection and integration
evaluation_scope: Known-WAV unused chunks, developmental repeated splits; not independent new-day validation
candidate_selection: Three-fold shuffled chunk CV inside each fit; minimize clean MSE, tie by grid order. Outer/OOF-held labels excluded.
target_scaling: MinMaxScaler fitted inside each fit; Kernel Ridge uses StandardScaler target to revert toward training mean out of support

integration.floor_rationale: Explicit research design controls retaining all members; not derived from test results or asserted optimal
integration.fifth_family_selection: Clean OOF integration-fit MSE among the nine candidate families; external result not used
integration.unrestricted_simplex: Diagnostic only, permits RF weight zero and therefore does not count as preserving three

status: Conditions fixed before new candidate fits; models and selected integrations saved separately from historical results
